newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MAGIC RE-SIGN FREE AGENT GERALD WILKINS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MAGIC RE-SIGN FREE AGENT GERALD WILKINS.

text.p: The Orlando Magic Wednesday re-signed their third free agent, bringing veteran guard/forward Gerald Wilkins back for his second season with the club.

The 33-year-old Wilkins averaged 10.6 points, 2.2 assists and 2.2 rebounds in 80 games last season, including 26 starts. He scored in double figures 44 times with a season-high 25 points against Dallas December 2.

"We're very excited to return a player of Gerald's character and experience," said Magic general manager John Gabriel. "He is the consummate professional and we feel he will continue to be very beneficial to our club, both on the floor and off. We're fortunate he has elected to return to our club."

Wilkins, younger brother of likely future Hall of Famer Dominique Wilkins, has averaged 13.8 points, 3.2 assists and 3.1 boards over 825 career games with New York, Cleveland, Vancouver and Orlando in his 12-year NBA career.
Orlando had previously re-signed forward Derek Strong and forward-centre Amal McCaskill. Guard Nick Anderson and centre Danny Schayes remain free agents.
